name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-rule34
description: Search rule34.xxx posts by tag through the site's own API. Needs a rule34.xxx API key.

environmentVariables.name: RULE34_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric rule34.xxx account id, shown under API Access Credentials.

environmentVariables.name: RULE34_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: rule34.xxx API key, shown under API Access Credentials. One per person.

environmentVariables.name: RULE34_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1000, and never lower.

environmentVariables.name: RULE34_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
